title.narrative: Building CommunityResilience Against Climate Change in Kitui County

description.narrative: The Catholic Diocese of Kitui (CDOK), in partnership with Christian Aid Kenya, proposes a transformative initiative titled "Building Climate Against Climate Change in Kitui County. " The project seeks to empower vulnerable communities to effectively anticipate, plan for, and respond to the adverse impacts of climate change while building sustainable and thriving livelihoods. The initiative responds to the growing climate crisis in Kitui County, where communities suffer from recurent droughts, erratic rainfall, land degradation, and health risks. These challenges have severely impacted agricultural productivity, increasing poverty and food insecurity, particularly in rural and marginalized areas dependent on rain-fed agriculture and pastoralism. The project will pursue five interlinked objectives: enhancing access to climate information services, stengthening locally led disaster risk reduction and early warring systems, promoting climate-resilient agriculture and agroecological practices, building institutional capacity and climate governance at community and county levels and supporting post-shock recovery while addressing long-term challenges such as, land degradation, water inaccessibility and food insecurity. It will also emphasize research, learning, and evidence-based advocacy to inform inclusive and sustainable climate action. Key interventions will include the establishment of Community Climate Resilience Hubs, ffaining of 1000 smallholder farmers in regenerative and dryland farming techniques, and distribution of drought-tolerant .seeds and tools. The project will also support the capacity building of Ward Climate Change Planning Committees to integrate adaptation priorities into local development.
